_comment: Labeled query set for get_context correctness/usefulness benchmarking on the Travsr repo itself. category: literal (exact symbol exists), conceptual (NL, no literal symbol match), cross (spans files), nonsense (off-domain, should abstain), salad (RFC-021: generic verb collides with a real symbol name but the query has no real meaning here — should ALSO abstain; kept distinct from nonsense so a regression in one doesn't hide in the other's aggregate). expect: substrings; a result HITS if any returned node sig OR path contains any expect entry (case-insensitive). RFC-021 Phase 0 floor-sweep note: N≈27 total (16 positive, 11 negative) is a repo-self-dogfood calibration sample, not a statistically powered study — floors derived from it should be revisited once real usage telemetry exists.
